Step 1: Start date: 1164-11-30.  
Step 2: 47 weeks = 47 × 7 = 329 days. Add 4 days → total subtract 333 days.  
Step 3: 1164 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and 1164 mod 100 ≠ 0).  
Step 4: Subtract 333 days from 1164-11-30:  
- Go back 30 days → 1164-10-31.  
- Remaining 303 days: go back into previous months/years.  
From 1164-10-31:  
Oct: back 30 days → 1164-10-01, actually we need to subtract whole months:  
Better: 1164-11-30 minus 333 days:  
333 = 30+31+30+31+31+30+31+30+31+?  
Count: from Nov 30 back:  
Oct 31 (30 days), Sep 30 (61), Aug 31 (92), Jul 31 (123), Jun 30 (153), May 31 (184), Apr 30 (214), Mar 31 (245), Feb 29 (leap year) (274), Jan 31 (305).  
305 days subtracted → date = 1164-01-01.  
Remaining 333 - 305 = 28 more days back from 1164-01-01 → 1163-12-04.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1163-12-04
